                                            UNIT IV
Q8   A software manager is in charge of the development of a safety-critical software        (10)       CO4
     system, which is designed to control a radiotherapy machine to treat patients
     suffering from cancer. This system is embedded in the machine and must run on a
     special-purpose processor with a fixed amount of memory (256 Mbytes). The machine
     communicates with a patient database system to obtain the details of the patient and,
     after treatment, automatically records the radiation dose delivered and other
     treatment details in the database.

     The COCOMO method is used to estimate the effort required to develop this system
     and an estimate of 26 person-months is computed. All cost driver multipliers were set
     to 1 when making this estimate.

     Explain why this estimate should be adjusted to take project, personnel, product and
     organizational factors into account. Suggest four factors that might have significant
     effects on the initial COCOMO estimate. Justify why you have included each factor?
